output_list.criticism: The contract uses the current block timestamp as a dependency, which can be manipulated by miners to influence the outcome of certain functions.
The transferFrom function does not check if the sender has sufficient allowance for the transfer.
The burnFrom function does not check if the sender has sufficient balance for the burn.
The mintToken function does not check if the contract has sufficient balance to mint tokens.
The freezeAccount function does not check if the contract has sufficient balance to freeze accounts.
